Paper Name: Sizing and Design of a PV-Wind-Fuel Cell Storage System Integrated into a Grid Considering the Uncertainty of Load Demand Using the Marine Predators Algorithm
NOTES: Optimal sizing results from MPA (Case 1, no uncertainty) used as baseline. Paper reports COE (not LCOE) — COE value placed in both COE and LCOE fields per inference rules. Load demand profile given as hourly data (8760 h) for Marsa Alam, Egypt but no explicit total annual kWh value stated — left blank. Rated power of PV module (Pr_pv) not explicitly stated in W or kW per panel. Wind turbine rated power (Pr_w) not explicitly stated per unit. Cut-in and rated wind speeds not explicitly stated. Electrolyzer efficiency (eta_EL) stated as constant but no numerical value given. FC efficiency (eta_FC) not numerically stated. PV efficiency (eta_PV) and wiring efficiency (eta_wire) not numerically stated. No diesel generator (DG) in this system — all DG-related fields null. No emission factors reported. Grid purchase price 0.08 $/kWh, sell price 0.2 $/kWh. H2_LHV reported as 39.7 kWh/m2 (unit appears to be kWh/kg in standard literature — noted as reported). Hydrogen tank efficiency 95%. Inverter efficiency 90%. System lifetime 25 years, interest rate 6%. FC lifetime conflicting: abstract says 15 years, Section 6 says 5 years — Table 1 shows 15 years. Used Table 1 value (15 years) for life_FC. Replacement cost for PV listed as '---' (zero or included in capital). No O&M cost for H2 tank per unit explicitly — Table 1 shows 2250.4 for H2 tank. Component lifetimes from Table 1: WT=20, PV=25, Electrolyzer=20, H2 tank=20, FC=15, Inverter=15 (inverter lifetime not in table — assumed same as FC at 15 based on typical design, but table only lists 6 rows for 6 components; inverter lifetime row shows 15 in the Lifetime row under Inverter column).
